name: How long does home addition design take in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How long does it usually take to go from first meeting to finished plans?
mainEntity.text: How long does it usually take to go from first meeting to finished plans?

acceptedAnswer.text: Home addition design timelines vary widely because every project starts with a different level of complexity. A straightforward rear extension may move through concept sketches and plan development relatively quickly, while a second-story addition or major structural rework can take much longer. The main factors are how quickly decisions are made, whether a survey or structural assessment is needed, how many revisions are requested, and whether the design must accommodate challenging site conditions. Older homes often require more time because hidden framing issues, foundation limits, and roof tie-ins must be studied carefully. If the project will need city approvals, the design package should be complete enough to reduce resubmittals. Homeowners should expect the design phase to move slower than they first assume, especially when they want a custom result instead of a basic box addition. Starting with a clear scope and budget helps keep the process efficient.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple addition design can take several weeks, while more complex projects can take a few months or longer. The timeline depends on scope, revisions, engineering, survey work, and permit readiness. Second-story additions and older homes usually take longer because structural and code issues must be resolved before final plans are complete.
